diagnosis: 60pF and1000pF VREF-to-CTRL capacitors cannot close both excursion and recovery. Original Miller capacitor couples output gate to the slower first-stage N2 node; the largest feedforward adds a second slow energy store.

bounded_compensation_test.rationale: Same order as original30pF multiplied by a several-fold second-stage gain; first test local loop before transient.
bounded_compensation_test.unchanged: CSENSE30pF, all39MOS and full distributed RC, synthetic LED, external0.5V VSET

bounded_startup_test.rationale: Isolate rapid raw VIN rise; bootstrap gate with VIN initially. START then discharges the gate through finite resistance; run-time path is the MOS channel, not the old100ohm100nF filter.
bounded_startup_test.boundary: No output reservoir cap; gate capacitor and resistors are explicit external components. START is an external sequence assumption, not autonomous POR.
